Here are the requested examples.

## 1. Inline math

For a quadratic equation $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$ with $a \neq 0$, the solutions are given by the quadratic formula: $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.

## 2. Display math with aligned equations

$$
\begin{aligned}
x + y &= 5 \\
2x - y &= 1
\end{aligned}
$$

## 3. Matrices and cases

$$
I = \begin{pmatrix}
1 & 0 \\
0 & 1
\end{pmatrix},
\quad
f(x) =
\begin{cases}
x^2 & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\
-x & \text{if } x < 0
\end{cases}
$$

## 4. Multiple equations

$$
E = mc^2
$$

$$
F = ma
$$

$$
a^2 + b^2 = c^2
$$

## 5. Links

See [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_formula) for more details on the quadratic formula.

## 6. Money context

The item costs \$5 and the shipping is \$10, for a total of \$15. Budget: \$1000 (escaped dollar).
